business_summary: Allied Sustainability and Environmental Consultants Group Limited, an investment holding company, provides green building certification, sustainability and environmental, acoustic, noise and vibration control, audio-visual design, and social and governance reporting consultancy services. The company offers green building certification consultancy services for property developers, contractors, architects, designers, and government departments; and integrated planning and design solutions that support urban regeneration, infrastructure development, and environmental compliance, as well as environmental impact assessments, air quality impact assessments, noise impact assessments, air ventilation assessments, water quality and waste management studies, carbon and energy audits, and built environment research. It also provides services to support architects, engineers, and developers; and architectural and building acoustics, mechanical and airborne noise control, sound reinforcement and public address systems, theatre planning and stage equipment design, and facade and feature lighting design services. In addition, the company offers ESG strategy formulation, governance framework design, materiality assessment, stakeholder engagement, climate risk and opportunity analysis, decarbonization roadmap development, and ESG report preparation services; and Sustainature, an online ESG management platform. It serves customers in the People's Republic of China and Southeast Asia. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Wan Chai, Hong Kong. Allied Sustainability and Environmental Consultants Group Limited operates as a subsidiary of Gold Investments Limited.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Allied Sustainability and Environmental Consultants Group Limited는 녹색 건물 인증, 지속 가능성 및 환경, 음향, 소음 및 진동 제어, 시청각 디자인, 사회 및 거버넌스 보고 컨설팅 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 부동산 개발자, 계약자, 건축가, 설계자 및 정부 부서를 대상으로 녹색 건물 인증 컨설팅 서비스를 제공합니다. 도시 재생, 인프라 개발, 환경 규정 준수는 물론 환경 영향 평가, 대기 질 영향 평가, 소음 영향 평가, 공기 환기 평가, 수질 및 폐기물 관리 연구, 탄소 및 에너지 감사, 건축 환경 연구를 지원하는 통합 계획 및 설계 솔루션입니다. 또한 건축가, 엔지니어 및 개발자를 지원하는 서비스도 제공합니다. 건축 및 건축 음향, 기계 및 공중 소음 제어, 음향 강화 및 전관 방송 시스템, 극장 계획 및 무대 장비 설계, 외관 및 기능 조명 설계 서비스. 또한 회사는 ESG 전략 수립, 거버넌스 프레임워크 설계를 제공합니다.
